analysis.reasonEn: Current price $77.05 is 17.9% of 52-week low $28.12. Broke below short-term moving averages like SMA5 $95.67 and SMA20 $114.04. RSI at 34.1 entering oversold territory. MACD histogram improving to -1.9536 but still negative. ADX at 27.0 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (43.6) is stronger than +DI (19.0). Weekly RSI is 40.2 and weekly MACD histogram is -9.8769, showing weakness. 4-hour RSI at 29.1 entering oversold. Overall, the downtrend persists, but there's potential for a rebound due to oversold conditions. Short-term attempts at rallies exist, but the medium-to-long-term trend remains weak. Caution is advised, waiting for confirmation of a trend reversal.
